problems.title: Algorithms

parts.prompt: Allows up to 2× the limit at window boundaries:
Exact, but stores every request time:

problems.solution: Fixed windows double up at boundaries; sliding logs are exact but costly.

problems.title: Token bucket
problems.statement: Capacity 5, refill 1 token/s; six requests of cost 1 at t = 0, then one at 1.0 s and one at 1.5 s.
problems.solution: Five pass, the sixth fails; by 1.0 s one token has refilled; at 1.5 s only half a token.

problems.title: Conflicts
problems.statement: Two replicas accept concurrent writes to a shopping cart.

options: it silently drops one user action
keep both versions (vector clocks) and merge in the application

problems.solution: The cart merges by union (deleted items can reappear, a documented trade-off).

problems.title: Distributed limiter
problems.statement: A global limit of 10,000 req/s across 20 gateway nodes.

options: each node enforces ~500/s locally and periodically rebalances shares
every request calls a central Redis

problems.solution: A central counter adds a network hop per request; local shares are approximate but fast.
